$comment: Axe.Windows rule violations accepted for now in the offscreen UIA smoke scan. Keys are ruleId|controlType|automationId as the scan reports them. Counts matter: these elements are generated chrome with no automation id, so without a count one recorded entry would absorb every future violation of the same shape. A key that is not listed, or a count higher than the one recorded, fails WpfUiAutomationSmokeTests.AxeWindowsScan_FindsNoViolationOutsideTheRecordedBaseline. Regenerate by running that test and reading the failure message. The state set here must match WpfUiAutomationSmokeTests.AccessibilityScanStates; AxeBaseline_RecordsEveryScannedState fails when they drift, so a newly scanned state cannot quietly run without a baseline.
